committed_before_any_measurement: In the commit before the first scan.
gate: Not a completion gate of M5. It is the M5 item for a raycast sensor on Metal ray tracing.

protocol.scene: A floor at z = 0, a box and a sphere, in Mitsuba metal_ad_rgb
protocol.reference: Exact distances to the same shapes, in float64
protocol.pattern: 16 elevations from -25 to +5 degrees, 1024 azimuths, range limit 20 m

reasons.range_limit_m: 1 mm at up to 20 m. Rays are float32, whose spacing at 20 m is about 2 micrometers, so this leaves room for the renderer's own ray start offset.
reasons.hit_mismatch_limit: A ray on the edge of a shape can go either way in float32. One ray in a thousand is far more than those edges.

not_shown: A real sensor's beam width, reflectivity, noise, or motion during a sweep. Any comparison with an RTX LiDAR. Whether the Metal ray tracing circuit ran: no counter was read.
